STUDENT
A NOTE TO THE
Dear Student,
C
AT or Common Admission Test is the most popular entrance exam in India for admission 
to top IIMs and other B-schools. Every year, lakhs of students take the CAT exam for ad -
mission to the top B-schools in the country. 
If you want to excel in the CAT examination, practice is the key. So, practicing the best Multiple 
Choice Questions (MCQs) will help you achieve the best rank in the examination. After covering 
the theory from the syllabus of the CAT, it’s always recommended to practice more and more 
MCQs from authentic resources. 
We at Careers360, created the most authentic MCQs with the help of expert faculties. The CAT 
exam is a national-level entrance exam that tests students on different parameters like Quan -
titative Aptitude, Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning, and Verbal Ability and Reading 
Comprehension. This two-hour paper will have a total of 66 questions, with sectional timings 
of 40 minutes each. 
Hence, it is very important to practice as many MCQs as possible to improve time management 
skills. Also, practicing MCQs will help you become well aware of different question types, levels 
of the questions and help you refine your attempt strategy. So, practice a lot of MCQs to excel 
in CAT.
All the best
Team Careers360
www.careers360.com
3


ABOUT THE EBOOK
In this eBook, you will find chapter-wise CAT MCQs with comprehensive solutions to better 
aid your understanding. It covers all the key topics included in the CAT syllabus: Quantitative 
Aptitude, Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning, and Verbal Ability and Reading Compre -
hension. 
The detailed solutions will help students to understand the logic behind each correct answer, 
and thus they’ll be able to solve similar questions in the exam. In addition, the eBook gives stu-
dents insight into the exam pattern and syllabus by adhering to the criteria and syllabus set for 
the CAT 2024 exam.
www.careers360.com
